info.name: Apifreaks Api Hub For Developers GeoDB APIs API
Retrieve detailed information about a specific administrative unit

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., US, PK).

params.name: admin_unit
params.description: Admin code of the administrative unit being requested.

items.docs: Returns comprehensive details for a single administrative unit identified by country code and admin code.

info.name: Retrieve administrative level types for a country

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., US, PK).

items.docs: Returns the distinct administrative level types (e.g., province, district, state) defined for a given country using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

info.name: Retrieve administrative units for a country with optional level filtering

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., US, PK).

params.name: admin_level
params.description: Comma-separated list to filter results by one or more administrative levels (e.g., state, district). A level name that doesn't exist for the country returns a 200 with an empty admin_units array rather than an error.

items.docs: Returns all administrative units (states, provinces, districts) for a country using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Optionally filter by one or more admin levels.

info.name: Retrieve cities for a country with optional admin unit filtering

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., US, PK).

params.name: admin_unit
params.description: Administrative unit code used to filter cities within a specific region. An admin_unit code that doesn't exist for the specified country returns a 400 error, not an empty result.

items.docs: Returns all cities for a country, optionally filtered by administrative unit. Each city includes name, coordinates, admin unit details, and ISO country code.

info.name: Retrieve comprehensive metadata for a specific country

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., US, PK).

items.docs: Returns complete country details for a single country identified by its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, including ISO codes, capital, currency, phone code, nationality, and flag emoji.

info.name: Retrieve a list of countries with optional region or subregion filtering

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: region
params.description: Optional filter to return countries within a specific region (e.g., Europe, Asia).

params.name: subregion
params.description: Optional filter to return countries within a specific subregion (e.g., Northern Europe, Southern Asia).

items.docs: Returns all countries with their ISO codes, capital cities, regions, and subregions. Optional region and subregion parameters narrow results.

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

items.docs: Returns all geographical regions supported by the service, such as Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Oceania, and Polar.

info.name: Retrieve subregions for a specific geographical region

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: region
params.description: Name of the region to retrieve subregions for. Omit to return all subregions across every region.

items.docs: Returns all subregions within a specified region, or all subregions across every region when the region parameter is omitted.
